newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA SHARES END DOWN IN POSSIBLE CORRECTION.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA SHARES END DOWN IN POSSIBLE CORRECTION.

text.p: Most Estonian share prices closed lower on Monday after the past weeks' bull runs with dealers saying that this could be the start of a slight correction.
Total trade on the main list was 166 million kroons as the Talse index fell 2.43 percent for a close of 412.01.
"There are still plently of buyers about and we don't think that share prices will fall very far," one trader said.
"The next few days will give us a good indication of the market trend for the next week," he added.
Hansapank was the most active stock with 48.5 million kroons traded to drop 9.20 kroons to 224.30 kroons.
"It is a big fall, but we are still seeing lots of demand for Hansapank shares, so it is not going down by very much," another trader said.
Hoiupank fell on opening but regained some lost ground during the day. It registered trade of 35 million kroons for a close of 265 kroons, a loss of five kroons.
Uhispank was one of the few banking stocks to gain as it picked up 0.50 kroons to close on a record high of 99 kroons after turning over 36.9 million kroons.
"We should see some more interest during the next few days in this stock," one dealer said.
"Local investors will see the price gaining and they should respond to this," he added.
On the free market, total trade was five million kroons.
Rakvere meat plant was the most active stock with 2.3 million kroons changing hands to gain 0.20 kroons to close at 13.20 kroons.
